positions.name: RollbackRehearsalMandate
positions.frame: what counts as a rollback capability actually existing, and who is accountable for keeping it real through rehearsal?
positions.why: src-1 sets the monthly cadence as a standing directive; src-2 supplies the justifying claim that an unrehearsed rollback isn't a rollback at all — the rationale behind the mandate. src-3 and src-4 are the session's own restatement of the same cadence and the ownership assignment (Quinton Fairweather) as bullet-point commentary, not independent witness, but they read in the same direction: establishing both the recurring practice and who is answerable for it. Held together, the group reads as one directional stance on what makes rollback readiness real and who bears it, rather than four separate claims.
